canonical_title: Minimum intensities in the horizontal plane of [position lights.]

versions.title_at_revision:
Minimum intensities in the horizontal plane of forward and rear position 
lights.
versions.text: Each position light intensity must equal or exceed the applicable values in the following table: Dihedral angle (light included) Angle from right or left of longitudinal axis, measured from dead ahead Intensity (candles) L and R (forward red and green). 0° to 10°--------------------------------- 10° to 20°------------------------------- 40 30 20° to 110°----------------------------- 5 A (rear white)---------------- 110° to 180°--------------------------- 20
